Privacy & Domain Preferences
Enable Ambient Keystroke Tracking Silently monitors typing bursts on non-sensitive inputs.

Zero-Trust Local Privacy: Amanuensis automatically skips password inputs, credit cards, banking domains, and token fields. Raw keystrokes and sentences are never buffered or recorded. All data is processed in memory and saved to your device's local storage.
